# The replay corpus's prompts (tests/replay_test.rs). Synthetic, modeled on the shapes of real
# prompts: short asks, long complaints about a hook, corrections that restate context, asks that
# name a file, asks about the relay. This repository is public, so no line here carries a real
# person's or client's name, a real path or a secret; `replay_corpus_has_no_real_names` checks it.
# One prompt per line. Blank lines and lines starting with # are skipped.
